race.comment: CARRY TRADE (5) has come back with two good runs this time in, just finding one better first up at Seymour before a good effort here over 1400m despite racing wide. Gets a kinder gate this time and should be ready to fire third up. CORRETTO (10) made nice improvement at start two to grab second at Ballarat Synthetic after showing early speed. Up to a mile looks to suit nicely now and he can improve again. HIS LADY BAY (7) has been sound in two runs back and looks set to peak here. She was beaten at $1.90 at Naracoorte last time but the fresh run reads well enough. SHEISTHEBOSS (8) was okay first up at Seymour over 1400m and will strip fitter with the suitable rise in trip. NEW PROSPECT (3) next best.
